description: Call one named tool on an http / http-x402 listing (tool name appended to the endpoint path, args as JSON body). Paid calls settle via ArisPay and need ARISPAY_API_KEY. For mcp-* listings use install_agent instead.

args.description: JSON args passed as the POST body

method.description: HTTP method. Defaults to POST when args are supplied.

tool.description: Tool name — appended to the listing endpoint URL as a path

name: proxy_tool_call
